quote: We employ five different models: BART, vanilla T5, UnifiedQA-v2 which uses a T5 backbone and has been fine-tuned on other QA datasets but not on HotpotQA, LLaMA-7B and Alpaca-7B.
outputs: The model generates answers to multi-step questions, either directly or via decomposition steps.

quote: t5-base DROP Implicit Decomp. is 33.7% exact match ± 0.9% vs No Decomp 34.0% ± 0.4%
We find that No Decomp method still performs similarly or outperforms all other decomposition methods (e.g. for Alpaca 59.9 EM with No Decomp vs 54.8 EM for Explicit Decomp).

All bars are the mean of three random seeds and error bars indicate the standard deviation. We see that most methods perform nearly the same, except for two that underperform: Explicit and Explicit + Implicit.
